meta.title: Powered by Kota: Institute Partnership in Pune | D-SAP
meta.description: How D-SAP Ghule Tutorials works with a top coaching institute in Kota: what comes from Kota, what we do in Pune, and how you can check it.

intro.text: D-SAP Ghule Tutorials is affiliated with a top coaching institute in Kota, which powers our JEE programme. This page sets out what that means, in plain words.

sections.heading: Our partner in Kota
body: Our JEE programme is powered by {{fact:partner.name}}, a coaching institute in Kota. Its name and logo appear on this page with its written permission.

sections.heading: What the affiliation covers
body: If this page ever says more than the agreement does, the agreement is right, and we will correct the page.

body.text: These parts of the programme come from Kota.

points.text: Faculty from Kota, teaching here in Pune.
The study material for JEE Main and Advanced.
The calendar of tests, from chapter tests to full mocks.

sections.heading: What we do in Pune
body: The centres, the batches and the day-to-day care are ours: two centres in New Sangvi and Wakad, at most {{fact:batch.size}} students in a batch, and classes {{fact:batch.days}} from {{fact:batch.timings#start}} to {{fact:batch.timings#end}}.

body.text: D-SAP Ghule Tutorials has taught in Pimpri-Chinchwad since {{fact:org.founded#year}}. Your child is taught by faculty from Kota and looked after by people who know Pune, and you meet them at parent-teacher meetings.

sections.heading: How you can check this
body: You should not have to take a coaching class's word for it. Here is what you can check yourself.

points.text: The name of our partner in Kota is on this page, so you can contact the institute yourself.
Ask to see the affiliation letter at either centre.

points: Read what parents say on the Google Business Profiles of both our centres.
Visit a centre and ask your questions in person before you decide.

sections.heading: Where the programme runs
body: The programme runs at both our centres, in New Sangvi and Wakad.

questions.q: Is this the same as studying in Kota?

a.text: The programme is powered by a top Kota institute and taught by faculty from Kota. What changes is the setting: your child lives at home and studies in Pune.
D-SAP Ghule Tutorials owns its name and trademark. {{fact:org.founder#name}} founded it in {{fact:org.founded#place}} in {{fact:org.founded#year}}.

questions.a: Call {{fact:contact.phone}} to fix a visit to a centre, and ask to meet the teachers.
